name: studens
description: A teacher you can interrupt: interactive HTML lessons in a local web UI, with highlight-to-ask questions and graded quizzes.

interface.shortDescription: Interactive lessons you can ask questions inside
interface.longDescription: Learn a topic one short lesson at a time. Lessons open in a local web UI. Highlight any passage to ask about it, and hand in quizzes to be graded, without leaving the page.
